verdict.rationale: Slate is a locally installed CLI/TUI agent. Its documented background subagents, multi-hour sessions and manual integration testing are local, adjacent capabilities. The evidence never shows a cloud-hosted agent that builds, tests and produces a demo of a feature for review, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review
